summary: US Foods, Inc., subsidiary of US Foods Holding Corp., entered a Fourteenth Amendment to its Amended and Restated Term Loan Credit Agreement on October 2, 2026, creating an $810 million incremental senior secured 2026 Term Loan Facility maturing October 2, 2033. Proceeds, with cash on hand, repay existing 2028 term loans, partly prepay 2031 term loans and ABL revolver borrowings, and cover fees. Pricing is Term SOFR plus 150 bps or base rate plus 50 bps, 1% quarterly amortization, secured by subsidiary stock and non-real-estate assets. This is a routine credit-facility refinancing, not a special situation.
